comment: Synthetic recipe catalog for the meal-planning loop (docs/meal-planning-final-strategy.md). Prices are per typical purchase pack (USD); cost math buys one pack per missing ingredient (v1 'have any = covered'). Allergen-bearing recipes (shellfish, peanuts, tree nuts, fish) are deliberately included so L1 safety filtering is demonstrable.

recipes.title: Spaghetti Carbonara
recipes.desc: Silky Roman pasta with crisp bacon, egg, and parmesan.
steps: Boil spaghetti until al dente; reserve a cup of pasta water.
Crisp bacon, then toss pasta in the fat off heat.
Stir in beaten eggs and parmesan with pasta water until silky; finish with black pepper.

recipes.title: Margherita Flatbread
recipes.desc: Crisp flatbread with marinara, fresh mozzarella, and basil.
steps: Spread marinara over flatbreads and top with torn mozzarella.
Bake at 450°F until bubbling and edges crisp, about 10 minutes.
Finish with basil and a drizzle of olive oil.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.desc: Breaded chicken cutlets baked under marinara and mozzarella.
steps: Bread pounded cutlets in flour, egg, then panko; pan-fry until golden.
Top with marinara and mozzarella; bake until cheese melts.
Serve over spaghetti with parmesan.

recipes.title: Mushroom Risotto
recipes.desc: Creamy arborio rice with sautéed mushrooms and parmesan.
steps: Sauté mushrooms in butter and set aside; soften onion and garlic.
Toast rice, deglaze with wine, then ladle in warm broth gradually, stirring.
Fold in mushrooms, parmesan, and butter; rest 2 minutes and serve.

recipes.title: Pesto Penne with Chicken
recipes.desc: Penne and seared chicken tossed in basil pesto with cherry tomatoes. Contains pine nuts (pesto).
steps: Boil penne; sear sliced chicken in olive oil until cooked through.
Toss pasta, chicken, and halved tomatoes with pesto and a splash of pasta water.
Top with parmesan.

recipes.title: Sausage and Peppers Rigatoni
recipes.desc: Rigatoni with browned Italian sausage, peppers, and tomato sauce.
steps: Brown crumbled sausage; sauté peppers, onion, and garlic in the fat.
Add tomatoes and simmer 15 minutes.
Toss with rigatoni and finish with parmesan.

recipes.title: Caprese Chicken Skillet
recipes.desc: Seared chicken topped with mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil.
steps: Sear seasoned chicken breasts until nearly cooked.
Top with tomato slices and mozzarella; cover until cheese melts.
Finish with basil.

recipes.title: Beef Lasagna
recipes.desc: Layered lasagna with beef ragu, creamy béchamel, and mozzarella.
steps: Simmer a beef ragu with tomatoes, paste, onion, and garlic.
Make a béchamel from butter, flour, and milk.
Layer noodles, ragu, béchamel, and cheese; bake at 375°F for 45 minutes.

recipes.title: Tilapia Piccata
recipes.desc: Pan-seared tilapia in a lemon, butter, and caper sauce. Contains fish.
steps: Dredge tilapia in flour and pan-sear in butter until golden.
Deglaze with wine and lemon juice; stir in capers and remaining butter.
Spoon sauce over fish and finish with parsley.

recipes.title: Chicken Street Tacos
recipes.desc: Charred chicken thighs in corn tortillas with onion, cilantro, and lime.
steps: Season chicken with chili powder and cumin; sear until charred and cooked.
Chop and pile into warmed tortillas.
Top with onion, cilantro, salsa, and lime.

recipes.title: Beef Burrito Bowls
recipes.desc: Seasoned ground beef over rice with beans, salsa, and avocado.
steps: Cook rice; brown beef with chili powder.
Warm beans; chop lettuce and avocado.
Assemble bowls and top with cheese, salsa, and lime.

recipes.title: Veggie Quesadillas
recipes.desc: Crispy tortillas stuffed with peppers, beans, corn, and melty cheese.
steps: Sauté peppers and onion; stir in beans and corn.
Fill tortillas with veggies and cheese; toast until crisp and melted.
Serve with sour cream and salsa.

recipes.title: Slow Carnitas
recipes.desc: Citrusy braised pork shoulder, crisped and served with tortillas.
steps: Braise pork with juices, onion, garlic, and spices until shreddable, about 3 hours.
Shred and crisp under the broiler.
Serve in tortillas with cilantro and lime.

recipes.title: Shrimp Fajitas
recipes.desc: Sizzling shrimp with charred peppers and onions. Contains shellfish.
steps: Toss shrimp with spices; char peppers and onion in a hot skillet.
Add shrimp and cook 3 minutes until pink.
Serve sizzling with warm tortillas, lime, and sour cream.

recipes.title: Black Bean Enchiladas
recipes.desc: Rolled tortillas with black beans and cheese under red enchilada sauce.
steps: Mash half the beans with sautéed onion and cumin; fill and roll tortillas.
Cover with enchilada sauce and cheese.
Bake at 375°F for 20 minutes; top with cilantro and sour cream.

recipes.title: Chilaquiles Verdes
recipes.desc: Tortilla chips simmered in salsa, topped with fried eggs and crema.
steps: Warm salsa in a wide skillet; fold in chips to coat.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Top chips with eggs, crema, crumbled cheese, onion, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Pork Al Pastor Bowls
recipes.desc: Chili-marinated pork with charred pineapple over rice.
steps: Marinate sliced pork in chili powder, garlic, and lime.
Sear pork and pineapple until charred.
Serve over rice with onion and cilantro.

recipes.title: Chicken Fried Rice
recipes.desc: Wok-fried rice with chicken, egg, peas, and scallions — best with day-old rice.
steps: Stir-fry diced chicken; scramble eggs and set aside.
Fry cold rice with garlic, peas, and carrots over high heat.
Toss everything with soy sauce and sesame oil; finish with scallions.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli
recipes.desc: Velveted beef and crisp broccoli in a glossy oyster sauce.
steps: Toss sliced beef with cornstarch and soy; blanch broccoli.
Sear beef hard, then stir-fry with garlic and ginger.
Add broccoli and oyster sauce; serve over rice.

recipes.title: Kung Pao Chicken
recipes.desc: Spicy stir-fried chicken with peanuts and chilies. Contains peanuts.
steps: Stir-fry diced chicken until golden.
Add garlic, peppers, chilies, and peanuts.
Toss with the soy-vinegar sauce until glossy; serve over rice.

recipes.title: Mapo Tofu
recipes.desc: Silky tofu and ground pork in a numbing-spicy sauce.
steps: Brown pork with garlic, ginger, and chili.
Add cubed tofu and a soy-based sauce; simmer gently.
Thicken with cornstarch slurry; serve over rice with scallions.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Pork
recipes.desc: Crispy pork with pineapple and peppers in a tangy glaze.
steps: Coat pork cubes in cornstarch and fry until crisp.
Make the glaze from ketchup, vinegar, sugar, and soy.
Toss pork, pineapple, and peppers in the glaze; serve over rice.

recipes.title: Garlic Green Beans with Pork
recipes.desc: Blistered green beans stir-fried with ground pork and garlic.
steps: Blister green beans in a hot wok; set aside.
Brown pork with garlic; return beans.
Season with soy, sugar, and sesame oil; serve over rice.

recipes.title: Sesame Peanut Noodles
recipes.desc: Chilled noodles in a creamy sesame-peanut sauce. Contains peanuts.
steps: Boil noodles, rinse cold.
Whisk peanut butter, soy, vinegar, sesame oil, and garlic into a sauce.
Toss noodles with sauce; top with cucumber, scallions, and sesame.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lo Mein
recipes.desc: Tossed noodles with cabbage, carrots, mushrooms, and scallions.
steps: Boil noodles; stir-fry vegetables over high heat.
Add noodles with soy, oyster sauce, and sesame oil.
Toss until glossy; finish with scallions.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon
recipes.desc: Glazed salmon with steamed rice and broccoli. Contains fish.
steps: Simmer soy, mirin, sugar, and ginger into a glaze.
Sear salmon, then lacquer with the glaze.
Serve over rice with steamed broccoli and sesame.

recipes.title: Chicken Katsu Curry
recipes.desc: Crispy panko chicken over rice with Japanese curry sauce.
steps: Simmer onion, carrot, and potato with broth and curry powder; thicken.
Bread cutlets and shallow-fry until golden.
Slice katsu over rice and ladle curry alongside.

recipes.title: Oyakodon
recipes.desc: Chicken and softly set egg simmered in sweet dashi over rice.
steps: Simmer chicken and onion in seasoned dashi.
Pour beaten egg over and cook until just set.
Slide over rice bowls and top with scallions.

recipes.title: Yaki Udon
recipes.desc: Chewy stir-fried udon with pork, cabbage, and a savory sauce.
steps: Brown pork; stir-fry cabbage and carrot.
Add cooked udon and the sauces.
Toss over high heat; finish with scallions.

recipes.title: Miso Glazed Cod
recipes.desc: Broiled cod with a sweet miso glaze, rice, and bok choy. Contains fish.
steps: Whisk miso, mirin, and sugar; coat cod.
Broil until caramelized and flaky, about 8 minutes.
Serve with rice and sesame-sautéed bok choy.

recipes.title: Gyudon Beef Bowls
recipes.desc: Thin-sliced beef and onions simmered sweet-savory over rice.
steps: Simmer onions in soy, mirin, sugar, and ginger.
Add shaved beef and cook just through.
Serve over rice, topped with a soft egg and scallions.

recipes.title: Shrimp Pad Thai
recipes.desc: Classic rice noodles with shrimp, egg, and crushed peanuts. Contains shellfish and peanuts.
steps: Soak noodles; mix fish sauce, sugar, and lime into a sauce.
Stir-fry shrimp and garlic; scramble in eggs.
Add noodles and sauce; toss and top with peanuts and scallions.

recipes.title: Green Curry Chicken
recipes.desc: Fragrant coconut green curry with chicken and vegetables.
steps: Fry curry paste in thick coconut cream.
Add chicken, remaining coconut milk, and vegetables; simmer 15 minutes.
Season with fish sauce; serve over jasmine rice with thai basil.

recipes.title: Pad Krapow Beef
recipes.desc: Fiery basil beef stir-fry topped with a crispy fried egg.
steps: Stir-fry garlic and chilies, then brown the beef hard.
Season with fish sauce, soy, and sugar; wilt in basil.
Serve over rice with crispy fried eggs.

recipes.title: Massaman Curry
recipes.desc: Rich braised beef curry with potatoes and peanuts. Contains peanuts.
steps: Fry curry paste in coconut cream; brown beef chunks.
Add coconut milk, potatoes, onion, and seasonings; braise 80 minutes.
Stir in peanuts; serve over jasmine rice.

recipes.title: Tom Kha Shrimp Soup
recipes.desc: Coconut-lemongrass soup with shrimp and mushrooms. Contains shellfish.
steps: Simmer coconut milk and broth with bruised lemongrass and ginger.
Add mushrooms, then shrimp until just pink.
Finish with lime, fish sauce, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Pineapple Fried Rice
recipes.desc: Sweet-savory fried rice with pineapple, cashews, and egg. Contains tree nuts.
steps: Scramble eggs and set aside; fry cold rice with curry powder.
Add pineapple, peas, and cashews.
Toss with soy and eggs; finish with scallions.

recipes.title: Butter Chicken
recipes.desc: Tandoori-spiced chicken in a creamy tomato sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices; broil until charred.
Simmer tomatoes with butter, garlic, and ginger; blend smooth.
Add chicken and cream; simmer and serve over basmati.

recipes.title: Chana Masala
recipes.desc: Spiced chickpea stew in a tangy tomato-onion gravy. Vegan.
steps: Brown onions deeply; add garlic, ginger, and spices.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer 20 minutes.
Serve over basmati with cilantro.

recipes.title: Palak Paneer
recipes.desc: Paneer cubes in a silky spiced spinach purée.
steps: Blanch spinach and blend to a purée.
Sauté onion, garlic, ginger, and spices; add purée and cream.
Fold in seared paneer; serve with basmati.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Masala
recipes.desc: Charred yogurt-marinated chicken in spiced tomato-cream sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices; broil until charred.
Simmer the onion-tomato sauce and blend; add cream.
Combine with chicken; serve over basmati.

recipes.title: Dal Tadka
recipes.desc: Comforting red lentils finished with sizzled garlic-spice butter. Vegan if oil used.
steps: Simmer lentils with turmeric until soft.
Sauté onion and tomato; stir into the dal.
Sizzle garlic and cumin in butter; pour over and serve with rice.

recipes.title: Aloo Gobi
recipes.desc: Dry-spiced potatoes and cauliflower with ginger and cilantro. Vegan.
steps: Fry cumin, onion, and ginger; add spices.
Add potatoes, cauliflower, and tomato; cover and steam-fry until tender.
Finish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Lamb Rogan Josh
recipes.desc: Slow-braised lamb in a deeply spiced yogurt-tomato gravy.
steps: Brown lamb; soften onions with garlic, ginger, and spices.
Add tomatoes and yogurt; braise low for 90 minutes.
Rest, skim, and serve over basmati with cilantro.

recipes.title: Vegetable Korma
recipes.desc: Mixed vegetables in a creamy cashew-coconut sauce. Contains tree nuts.
steps: Blend soaked cashews with coconut milk into a cream.
Sauté onion and spices; add vegetables and the cashew cream.
Simmer until tender; serve with basmati.

recipes.title: Classic Cheeseburgers
recipes.desc: Smash-style burgers with cheddar, lettuce, and special sauce.
steps: Mix mayo, ketchup, and mustard into a sauce; toast buns.
Smash beef patties in a ripping-hot skillet; top with cheddar.
Stack with lettuce, tomato, and onion.

recipes.title: BBQ Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.desc: Slow-cooked pork shoulder in barbecue sauce with slaw on buns.
steps: Rub pork with paprika and sugar; slow-cook until shreddable, about 4 hours.
Shred and toss with bbq sauce.
Pile onto buns with quick cabbage-carrot slaw.

recipes.title: Roast Chicken and Potatoes
recipes.desc: Whole roasted chicken over crispy herb potatoes.
steps: Rub chicken with butter and herbs; stuff with lemon and garlic.
Roast at 425°F over potatoes and carrots.
Rest 10 minutes before carving.

recipes.title: Baked Mac and Cheese
recipes.desc: Three-cheese baked macaroni with a crispy panko top.
steps: Make a cheese sauce from butter, flour, milk, and the cheeses.
Fold in cooked pasta; top with buttered panko.
Bake at 375°F until bubbling and golden.

recipes.title: Cobb Salad
recipes.desc: Loaded salad with chicken, bacon, egg, avocado, and blue-style dressing.
steps: Sear chicken; crisp bacon; soft-boil eggs.
Whisk a lemon-dijon vinaigrette.
Arrange everything over romaine and dress.

recipes.title: Chili con Carne
recipes.desc: Hearty beef and bean chili — better the next day.
steps: Brown beef with onion and garlic; bloom the spices.
Add tomatoes, beans, and broth; simmer 45 minutes.
Serve with cheddar and sour cream.

recipes.title: Glazed Meatloaf
recipes.desc: Classic meatloaf with a tangy ketchup glaze and mashed potatoes.
steps: Mix beef, egg, panko, and onion; shape into a loaf.
Glaze with ketchup, sugar, and mustard; bake at 375°F for an hour.
Serve with buttery mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Wraps
recipes.desc: Crispy buffalo-tossed chicken with ranch-style slaw in wraps.
steps: Sear chicken strips and toss in buffalo sauce.
Mix yogurt-mayo dressing with shredded lettuce, carrot, and celery.
Roll everything into warm wraps.

recipes.title: Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
recipes.desc: Buttery grilled cheese with quick creamy tomato soup.
steps: Simmer tomatoes with onion, garlic, and broth; blend with cream.
Griddle buttered cheese sandwiches until molten.
Serve together with torn basil.

recipes.title: Steak with Mashed Potatoes
recipes.desc: Pan-seared sirloin with garlic butter and creamy mash.
steps: Boil and mash potatoes with butter and milk.
Sear steaks hard; baste with garlic-rosemary butter and rest.
Serve with blistered green beans.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Bowls
recipes.desc: Lemon-oregano chicken over rice with cucumber, feta, and olives.
steps: Marinate chicken in lemon, oregano, and olive oil; sear and slice.
Build bowls over rice with cucumber, tomatoes, olives, and feta.
Top with lemony yogurt sauce.

recipes.title: Falafel Pita Wraps
recipes.desc: Crispy chickpea falafel in pita with tahini sauce. Vegan. Contains sesame.
steps: Blend chickpeas with herbs, garlic, cumin, and flour; form balls.
Shallow-fry until deeply crisp.
Stuff pitas with falafel, cucumber, tomato, and lemony tahini.

recipes.title: Shakshuka
recipes.desc: Eggs poached in spiced pepper-tomato sauce with crusty bread.
steps: Stew peppers, onion, and garlic with spices and tomatoes.
Nestle in eggs; cover until whites set.
Top with feta and parsley; serve with bread.

recipes.title: Greek Salad with Grilled Shrimp
recipes.desc: Crisp village salad topped with charred shrimp. Contains shellfish.
steps: Toss cucumbers, tomatoes, onion, olives, and feta with oil and oregano.
Grill lemony shrimp 2 minutes per side.
Pile shrimp over the salad.

recipes.title: Lemon Herb Baked Cod
recipes.desc: Cod baked with lemon, dill, and olive oil over couscous. Contains fish.
steps: Bake cod with lemon, garlic, dill, and olive oil at 400°F.
Steam couscous; wilt spinach with tomatoes.
Serve cod over couscous with pan juices.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki Plates
recipes.desc: Skewered lemon-garlic chicken with pita and yogurt sauce.
steps: Marinate chicken cubes in lemon, garlic, oregano, and oil; skewer and grill.
Stir cucumber and garlic into yogurt for tzatziki.
Serve with warm pita, tomato, and onion.

recipes.title: Stuffed Bell Peppers
recipes.desc: Peppers baked with a savory beef, rice, and tomato filling.
steps: Brown beef with onion and garlic; mix with cooked rice and tomatoes.
Stuff halved peppers and top with feta.
Bake covered at 375°F for 35 minutes.

recipes.title: Bibimbap
recipes.desc: Rice bowls with marinated beef, sautéed vegetables, egg, and gochujang.
steps: Sauté each vegetable separately with sesame oil; brown soy-garlic beef.
Fry eggs sunny-side up.
Arrange over rice with gochujang and sesame.

recipes.title: Beef Bulgogi
recipes.desc: Sweet-savory marinated beef seared hot, with rice and lettuce cups.
steps: Marinate shaved beef in soy, sugar, sesame, garlic, and ginger.
Sear in a screaming-hot pan in batches.
Serve with rice, lettuce cups, and scallions.

recipes.title: Kimchi Fried Rice
recipes.desc: Funky-spicy fried rice with kimchi, bacon, and a fried egg.
steps: Crisp bacon; fry chopped kimchi in the fat.
Add cold rice, gochujang, and soy; fry hard.
Top with fried eggs, sesame oil, and scallions.

recipes.title: Sundubu Tofu Stew
recipes.desc: Bubbling soft tofu stew with mushrooms and egg.
steps: Sauté kimchi, garlic, and gochujang in sesame oil.
Add broth, mushrooms, and soft tofu; simmer.
Crack in eggs off heat; serve bubbling with rice.

recipes.title: Gochujang Chicken Bowls
recipes.desc: Sticky-spicy glazed chicken over rice with quick cucumber salad.
steps: Sear chicken; glaze with gochujang, honey, soy, and garlic.
Quick-pickle cucumbers in vinegar.
Serve over rice with sesame and scallions.

recipes.title: Quick Chicken Pho
recipes.desc: Aromatic chicken noodle soup with herbs and lime.
steps: Simmer broth with charred ginger, onion, and cinnamon; poach chicken.
Cook noodles; slice chicken.
Assemble bowls and top with herbs, lime, and chili.

recipes.title: Banh Mi Rice Bowls
recipes.desc: Caramelized pork with pickled vegetables and sriracha mayo over rice.
steps: Quick-pickle carrot and cucumber in vinegar and sugar.
Brown pork with garlic, fish sauce, and a little sugar until caramelized.
Serve over rice with pickles, sriracha mayo, and cilantro.

recipes.title: Lemongrass Pork Chops
recipes.desc: Grilled lemongrass-marinated pork with rice and cucumber.
steps: Marinate pork in minced lemongrass, fish sauce, sugar, and garlic.
Grill or sear until charred and cooked through.
Serve over rice with cucumber and scallion-lime dressing.

recipes.title: Shrimp Spring Roll Bowls
recipes.desc: Deconstructed spring rolls: shrimp, noodles, herbs, peanut drizzle. Contains shellfish and peanuts.
steps: Poach shrimp; cook and rinse noodles cold.
Whisk peanut butter, hoisin, lime, and fish sauce into a drizzle.
Build bowls with lettuce, herbs, and vegetables; top with shrimp and sauce.

recipes.title: Coq au Vin
recipes.desc: Chicken braised in red wine with bacon, mushrooms, and pearl onions.
steps: Crisp bacon; brown chicken in the fat.
Braise with wine, broth, vegetables, and thyme for an hour.
Thicken with beurre manié; serve with baguette.

recipes.title: Ratatouille with White Beans
recipes.desc: Provençal stewed vegetables with beans and crusty bread. Vegan.
steps: Sauté eggplant, zucchini, and peppers in batches.
Stew with tomatoes, onion, garlic, beans, and thyme.
Finish with basil; serve with bread.

recipes.title: Croque Monsieur
recipes.desc: Griddled ham and gruyère sandwiches under béchamel, with greens.
steps: Make a quick béchamel with dijon.
Layer ham and gruyère between bread; top with béchamel and more cheese.
Bake until bubbling; serve with lemony spinach salad.

recipes.title: Salmon Niçoise Salad
recipes.desc: Seared salmon over potatoes, green beans, eggs, and olives. Contains fish.
steps: Boil potatoes, beans, and eggs; chill.
Sear salmon to medium.
Compose the salad and dress with lemon-dijon vinaigrette.

recipes.title: Chicken Shawarma Bowls
recipes.desc: Spiced roasted chicken over rice with tahini drizzle. Contains sesame.
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and warm spices; roast at 425°F until charred.
Whisk tahini with lemon and water.
Serve over rice with chopped salad and tahini.

recipes.title: Lamb Kofta with Couscous
recipes.desc: Spiced lamb skewers with herbed couscous and yogurt sauce.
steps: Mix lamb with grated onion, garlic, and spices; form onto skewers.
Grill until charred and just cooked.
Serve over herbed couscous with lemony yogurt.

recipes.title: Mujadara
recipes.desc: Lentils and rice crowned with deeply caramelized onions. Vegan.
steps: Caramelize sliced onions slowly in olive oil until deep brown.
Simmer lentils, then add rice, cumin, and bay; cook through.
Top with onions, yogurt, and parsley.

recipes.title: Hummus Bowls with Spiced Chicken
recipes.desc: Warm hummus topped with cumin chicken, pine-free crunch, and pita. Contains sesame.
steps: Sear spiced diced chicken in olive oil.
Swoosh hummus into bowls; pile chicken on top.
Add cucumber, tomatoes, parsley, and lemon; scoop with warm pita.

recipes.title: Tuna White Bean Salad
recipes.desc: No-cook pantry salad with tuna, beans, olives, and lemon. Contains fish.
steps: Flake tuna with chickpeas, onion, olives, and tomatoes.
Dress with lemon, olive oil, and parsley.
Serve with toasted baguette.

recipes.title: Caesar Salad with Chicken
recipes.desc: Crisp romaine, garlicky dressing, parmesan, and seared chicken. Contains fish (anchovy).
steps: Whisk a Caesar dressing from mayo, anchovy, garlic, lemon, and dijon.
Sear and slice the chicken.
Toss romaine with dressing, croutons, and parmesan; top with chicken.

recipes.title: Quinoa Power Bowls
recipes.desc: Quinoa with roasted sweet potato, kale, avocado, and lemon-tahini. Vegan. Contains sesame.
steps: Roast cubed sweet potato and chickpeas with paprika.
Cook quinoa; massage kale with lemon and oil.
Assemble bowls with avocado and lemon-tahini drizzle.

recipes.title: Turkey-Style Stuffed Sweet Potatoes
recipes.desc: Baked sweet potatoes loaded with black beans, corn, and cheese.
steps: Bake sweet potatoes at 400°F until tender.
Warm beans and corn with chili powder.
Split, stuff, and top with cheese, yogurt, scallions, and lime.

recipes.title: Almond-Crusted Chicken Tenders
recipes.desc: Oven-baked chicken tenders in a crunchy almond crust with honey mustard. Contains tree nuts.
steps: Pulse almonds into coarse crumbs with paprika.
Dip chicken strips in egg, then almonds; bake at 425°F until crisp.
Serve with honey-mustard and roasted green beans.

recipes.title: Walnut Pesto Zoodle Bowls
recipes.desc: Zucchini noodles and penne in walnut-basil pesto. Contains tree nuts.
steps: Blend walnuts, basil, parmesan, garlic, and oil into pesto.
Boil penne; ribbon the zucchini.
Toss everything with lemon and tomatoes.

recipes.title: Cashew Chicken
recipes.desc: Stir-fried chicken and toasted cashews in a glossy sauce. Contains tree nuts.
steps: Velvet chicken with cornstarch; stir-fry until golden.
Add garlic, peppers, and the hoisin-soy sauce.
Toss in toasted cashews; serve over rice with scallions.

recipes.title: One-Pot Lemon Orzo with Shrimp
recipes.desc: Creamy lemon couscous-style orzo with shrimp and spinach. Contains shellfish.
steps: Sauté garlic; toast couscous and simmer in broth.
Stir in shrimp and spinach until pink and wilted.
Finish with lemon, feta, and dill.

recipes.title: Veggie Egg Fried Rice
recipes.desc: Fast pantry fried rice with eggs and whatever vegetables need using.
steps: Scramble eggs and set aside.
Fry cold rice with garlic, carrots, and peas over high heat.
Toss with soy, sesame oil, eggs, and scallions.

recipes.title: Harissa-Style Chickpea Stew
recipes.desc: Smoky-spicy chickpea and tomato stew with greens. Vegan.
steps: Soften onion and garlic; bloom the spices in olive oil.
Add tomatoes and chickpeas; simmer 15 minutes.
Wilt in kale; finish with lemon and serve with pita.

recipes.title: Sheet-Pan Sausage and Veggies
recipes.desc: Everything roasts on one pan: sausage, potatoes, peppers, broccoli.
steps: Toss everything with oil, garlic, and oregano on a sheet pan.
Roast at 425°F for 30 minutes, tossing once.
Serve straight from the pan.

recipes.title: Caprese Orzo Salad
recipes.desc: Chilled couscous-style salad with mozzarella, tomatoes, and basil.
steps: Cook couscous and cool.
Toss with mozzarella, tomatoes, spinach, and basil.
Dress with lemon, garlic, and olive oil.
